description:
[Game reference] One tech tree: nodes and prerequisite edges. The full research graph for one workbench, from the game's own tech tree data. Every node costs ONE research
item, never scrap: `currency` says which - a Blueprint Fragment (Workbench Level 1 and Engineering Workbench), a
Blueprint Page (Level 2) or a Blueprint Book (Level 3) - at default server settings (a server can add a tax).
Unlocking a node also unlocks every locked node on the cheapest route back to the tree's start, one item each.
`nodes` carry `id`, `shortname`, `name`, `icon_url`, `cost` (1), `path_cost` (items to unlock it from scratch
with everything before it), `inputs` (prerequisite node ids - any one is enough) and `x`/`y`: LAYOUT PIXELS
(the top-left of a 110x78 card, see `card_size`) from the game's own graph positions. `edges` are the
prerequisite links (`from_id` before `to_id`) with the card-centre endpoints `x1`,`y1`,`x2`,`y2` the page
draws. `unlinked` lists nodes that are in the tree's data but have no route from its start (mostly moved to
the Engineering Workbench tree). Node ids are only stable until the tree is re-seeded. Cached for one hour. Costs are research items (Blueprint Fragment, Page or Book), never scrap. Link https://rust.wiki/tech-tree?tree=<tree>.
